propositions: Rebar lacks a first-class Bedrock provider and currently routes through an OpenAI gateway, forfeiting prompt caching and native structured output.

Bedrock requires ambient AWS credentials (instance role or AWS_PROFILE) and inference-profile model ids (on-demand ids are not invokable in measured environments), with us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 verified to cache (cache_write then cache_read on repeated calls) while some models silently fail to cache despite full input billing.
Caching failure is silent on some Bedrock models (cache_read=0, cache_write=0 with full input tokens billed), requiring a new warning predicate distinct from the existing zeroed-usage guard.

Bedrock rejects the temperature parameter on some models (ValidationException: deprecated for this model) while pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings only exists in the Anthropic leaf, causing hard failures where the direct-Anthropic path degrades gracefully.

The capability model must distinguish per-model API defects via exact model-id matching in a second override table (_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES) without widening the signed f184 contract (_REBAR_OVERRIDES signature stays single ModelProfile argument).

Sampling parameter errors matching the measured shape (400/ValidationException + parameter name + rejection word) must translate to actionable LLMConfigError naming the model and both remedies (add to override table or unset config) rather than swallowing unrelated 400s as LLMUnavailableError.
